title: MemoryAgentContractSchemas
description: Input/output contract schema bundle for the Memory Agent (Stage 8 — Memory). Governs working vs durable memory transactions; prevents covert per-agent durable stores. See /contracts/agents/memory-agent.md.

input.description: The memory operation request, its grounding source artifacts, retention policy, and an apply_token if required by policy for a material persist.

op.description: Only ops allowed by the current stage are permitted.

source_refs.description: Upstream artifacts this transaction is grounded in (typically Knowledge + EmbeddingJob).

retention_policy_id.description: Governed retention policy applied to this transaction.

apply_token.description: Required for material persist operations when policy demands a valid, version-bound token.
